subject: english
question: What would come in (3)
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**' i.e. **'no'**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage emphasizes students learning to set priorities and resist peer pressure.
 
• The phrase "learn to say _____ when needed" implies refusing requests or pressure.
 
• "**no**" correctly completes the sentence, as it conveys refusal in a polite or firm manner.
 
• Other options like 'later', 'sorry', or 'yes' do not fit logically in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: 'later'** – Incorrect; it does not convey refusal or boundary-setting.
 
• **Option 3: 'sorry'** – Incorrect; apologizing is not the intended advice here.
 
• **Option 4: 'yes'** – Incorrect; agreeing would go against the idea of setting priorities.
